observable: Relief of extracellular proton block of sodium current during depolarization in nodal membranes

woodhull1973-nodal-protons.locator: Fig. 4A and summary. Voltage is inside minus outside.
woodhull1973-nodal-protons.preparation: Myelinated frog nerve, voltage clamp. The paper estimates sodium permeability from peak sodium current.
woodhull1973-nodal-protons.uncertainty: Rounded examples in the paper. No pointwise uncertainty is attached to these two summary numbers. The +180 mV condition is above the Cells clamp range used here.

mozhayeva1984-nodal-protons.locator: Primary abstract, instantaneous sodium-current I–V under acidification.
mozhayeva1984-nodal-protons.preparation: Nodal membrane, external pH 4.8–4.9. The authors compared inward and outward current reductions over voltage.
mozhayeva1984-nodal-protons.uncertainty: The primary abstract supplies the direction and bath conditions. No pointwise values or slope uncertainty were extracted.

zhang1991-cardiac-protons.preparation: Guinea-pig ventricular myocytes, extracellular pH 5.5 and 7.4.
zhang1991-cardiac-protons.observation: External acid reduced unitary amplitude. Voltage dependence of the reduction was unresolved over this range.
zhang1991-cardiac-protons.uncertainty: Different tissue, voltage interval and single-channel readout from the two nodal studies.
